name: Beat Cut
tagline: Cuts a music video to your track's beat, frame by frame, on the cheap
description: Hand it an audio file and it produces a video whose cuts land exactly on the beat. If you have no track ready, it can compose a beat first and edit to its own rhythm instead. The frame-accurate slicing is done in plain code rather than through a model, which keeps token use and API spending low even on longer songs.
author: DisruptionUp
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
